definitions.explanation: The manner or method of doing something. A general, everyday word for approach or technique.

examples.japanese: やり{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please teach me how to do it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧やり{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I don't understand how to use this machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧やり{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧みよう。
examples.english: Let's change the old way of doing things and try a new method.

notes:
やり{方|かた} is formed from ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to do) + ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way). It is one of the most common ~⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ compounds.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: method (more formal, written)
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧: way of doing (slightly more formal)
- やり{方|かた}: way of doing (casual, everyday)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- やり{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (don't know how to do it)
- やり{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧ (change the way of doing things)
- やり{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (learn how to do something)
